results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. results.content: President Donald Trump's net approval rating has slipped into negative territory in eleven states Trump carried by at least ten points in 2024 — a shift that pushes his political challenges well past the handful of battlegrounds where erosion was already expected. results.title: Trump's Approval Turns Negative in 11 Red States He Won by Double Digits According to Civiqs Online Poll

results.content: Civiqs has been tracking this since the day Trump took the oath, and as of late July, Trump’s net approval in Texas sits at -13. Texas is one of eleven states Trump carried by double digits in 2024 where he’s now underwater, in the “should have been safe but isn’t” column.
